newsitem.title: USA: Hycor Biomedical test gets FDA clearance.
newsitem.headline: Hycor Biomedical test gets FDA clearance.

text.p: Hycor Biomedical Inc said Wednesday it has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market in the United States four additional autoimmune test kits for its HY-TEC automated diagnostic system.
This clearance brings the total autoimmune menu to thirteen tests.
"We are continuing to broaden our product offering to enhance the value of our new HY-TEC automated testing system," said Richard Hamill, chairman, president and chief executive officer.
HY-TEC is the an automated system designed to perform tests for both allergy and autoimmune disease.
